purpose: Region-locked combat BiS drop geography for Equilibrium: one row per major boss or boss family that defines elective/starting region value via unique combat gear, ability codices, or endgame upgrade materials. Not a strategy guide and not drop-rate research.

policy.region_rule: required_regions lists hard acquisition geography under the current repo League taxonomy (regions.json + major-upgrades-by-region.json + region-dependencies.json). region_hints / optional_pressure_regions cover cross-region chains or unresolved portals without inventing a second hard gate.
policy.league_rule: Senntisten EGWD, City of Um, Fort Forinthry, and Sanctum of Rebirth use working Misthalin taxonomy until Equilibrium publishes a finer locality. ED4 Zamorak is wiki-badged Misthalin but still carries a Forinthry portal residual warning. The Arc (ED1) stays unresolved external.
policy.bis_rule: effects lists the BiS / near-BiS uniques that make the boss region-defining. Skip pure fluff commons. Do not invent rates. Ironman notes are farm-access notes only.
policy.duplicate_rule: IDs are boss:slug hubs. Do not re-emit full igneous cape production detail already in cross-region:igneous-zuk-capes; this file only pins the boss drop side.

equipment_additions.name: Araxxor / Araxxi
effects: Spider leg assembly path for each noxious weapon
equipment_additions.notes: Official Equilibrium Morytania example. Ironman farm is the Araxyte Hive path only — no alternate region source for noxious components. Primary mid-end all-style t90 2h BiS gate.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Hard Morytania elective. Quest auto-completion does not relocate the hive.

equipment_additions.name: Rasial, the First Necromancer
effects: Robes of the First Necromancer (t95 Necromancy power armour set)
equipment_additions.notes: Citadel above City of Um. Ironman Necromancy endgame BiS is locked to this farm once Um access is open; Hermod is the citadel unlock step, not a separate BiS table. Working Misthalin taxonomy for Um/Underworld.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Keep Misthalin as working League region for City of Um until Equilibrium overrides locality.

equipment_additions.name: Kerapac, the bound
effects: Fractured Staff of Armadyl components (HM only: symbol / gem / shaft) — t95 magic 2h BiS special
equipment_additions.notes: Elder God Wars Dungeon / Senntisten front — NOT Anachronia. Ironman FSoA is hard-mode Kerapac only; GConc is a major magic DPS permanent. Working Misthalin Senntisten taxonomy.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Do not map Kerapac to Anachronia. Senntisten EGWD stays Misthalin working taxonomy.

equipment_additions.name: Arch-Glacor
effects: Leng artefact + dark nilas → Blade of Leng / Off-hand Blade of Leng (t95 melee dual)
Enhanced glove upgrade materials (glove path residual)
equipment_additions.notes: EGWD Senntisten. Ironman t95 melee dual is Leng from this boss; enrage/mechanics options scale loot without inventing rates here. Working Misthalin taxonomy.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Same Senntisten/Misthalin working map as Kerapac/Zuk/Croesus.

equipment_additions.name: Croesus
effects: Cryptbloom armour (t90 Magic tank — combat BiS residual, not a skilling-only row)
Croesus foultorch / sporehammer skilling off-hands (combat-adjacent note only)
equipment_additions.notes: EGWD skilling boss with real combat armour BiS for Magic tank setups. Ironman Cryptbloom is contribution-chest locked to this encounter. Skilling off-hands are secondary; do not treat Croesus as pure skilling when planning Magic tank.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Misthalin working Senntisten map. Safe encounter still requires region access to the front.

equipment_additions.name: TzKal-Zuk
effects: Igneous stone (flawless / no-checkpoint path) for Igneous Kal style capes
Magma Tempest ability codex (+ targeted variant)
equipment_additions.notes: TzekHaar Front / Senntisten working Misthalin map supplies the stone, weapon, ability, and scripture. Ironman igneous cape chain still needs a TokHaar-Kal base from Karamja Fight Kiln — see cross-region:igneous-zuk-capes. Obsidian armour / TokKul-Zo support is Karamja-side only.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Boss drops = Misthalin. Full BiS cape chain = Misthalin + Karamja.

equipment_additions.name: Sanctum of Rebirth (Nakatra residual)
effects: Roar of Awakening (t95 Magic main-hand) — Nakatra only
Ode to Deceit (t95 Magic off-hand) — Nakatra only
Shard of Genesis Essence (HM Nakatra — +5 tiers on t95 weapons)
equipment_additions.notes: Three-boss dungeon via City of Um / Underworld. Ironman t95 Magic dual and Genesis upgrade material are Nakatra-gated; Divine Rage / Scripture roll from the dungeon residual. Working Misthalin Um taxonomy.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Treat as Misthalin until Equilibrium remaps Underworld locality.

equipment_additions.name: Zamorak, Lord of Chaos (Undercity residual)
effects: Vestments of havoc (t95 melee power armour set)
Bow of the Last Guardian components (top / bottom / divine bowstring) — t95 ranged 2h
Codex of lost knowledge (Greater Sunshine / Greater Death's Swiftness craft path)
equipment_additions.notes: ED4 final boss. Wiki Equilibrium badge currently lists Misthalin; base-game entrance/escape is Senntisten while the portal chain hits Wilderness Crater / Vestibule of Futility (Forinthry residual). Ironman enrage farm supplies melee t95 armour + BOLG + key ability codices. Do not invent enrage rates.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Primary badge Misthalin; keep Forinthry as cross-boundary residual until Equilibrium resolves ED4 locality (see region-dependencies cross_boundary_cases).

equipment_additions.name: Telos, the Warden
effects: Dormant anima-core / orb of pure anima residual for anima-core upgrades
equipment_additions.notes: Heart of Gielinor — Desert elective, NOT Forinthry/Wilderness. Ironman t92 special-attack 2h weapons are enrage-chest gated here. Do not copy enrage strategy into the planner.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Desert/Heart mapping is current repo + Catalyst precedent. Do not reassign to Wilderness.

equipment_additions.name: God Wars Dungeon 2 (Heart of Gielinor)
effects: Dragon Rider lance (t85+ melee polearm still used for mobility specials)
Wand of the Cywir elders + Orb of the Cywir elders
Blade of Avaryss + Blade of Nymora (twin blades)
Anima core of Seren / Zaros / Zamorak / Sliske armour paths
equipment_additions.notes: Heart of Gielinor family (Helwyr, Twin Furies, Vindicta, Gregorovic) — Desert, not Asgarnia/Fremennik. 2026: best GWD2 drop rates available immediately; reputation no longer gates rates (cap 2,000). Ironman midgame all-style weapon ladder.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Hard Desert elective. Do not file under GWD1 Asgarnia.

equipment_additions.name: Amascut, the Devourer
effects: Devourer's Guard (t95 Necromancy shield / tank residual)
Tumeken's Light (t95 Necromancy light source residual)
Shard of Genesis Essence residual (shared endgame +5 t95 upgrade economy with Sanctum HM)
equipment_additions.notes: Menaphos Imperial district. Catalyst labelled Desert: Menaphos. Ironman Necromancy/Magic endgame residual alongside Sanctum; requires Eclipse of the Heart in the normal game.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Hard Desert. Quest auto-completion may soften Eclipse gates but not the Menaphos geography.

equipment_additions.name: God Wars Dungeon 1 (+ Nex)
effects: Nex: Torva / Pernix / Virtus (t80 power armour sets)
equipment_additions.notes: Official Equilibrium Asgarnia example (GWD approach). 2026: GWD1 killcount persists after leaving, capped at 200. Ironman midgame armour BiS before t90/t95 sets. Nex is the same dungeon complex, not a separate region.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Hard Asgarnia. Northern Asgarnia boundary includes the GWD approach.

equipment_additions.name: Nex: Angel of Death
effects: Wand of the praesul (t92 magic main-hand)
equipment_additions.notes: GWD complex Asgarnia. Ironman t92 Magic dual alternative to Telos staff path; group-content farm with distinct uniques from base Nex.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Same Asgarnia GWD geography as GWD1/Nex.

equipment_additions.name: Vorago
effects: Tectonic energy (t90 Magic power armour craft material)
equipment_additions.notes: Borehole near Falador — Asgarnia. Ironman seismic dual + tectonic armour energy farm. Hard-mode/team content; still the region-defining Magic mid-end BiS source before praesul/FSoA.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Hard Asgarnia. Do not file under Forinthry.

equipment_additions.name: Dragonkin Laboratory (ED2)
effects: Draconic energy (elite tectonic / elite sirenic residual materials)
equipment_additions.notes: Deep Wilderness Castle Ruins — hard Forinthry. Ironman melee ability upgrades (Greater Fury/Flurry/Barge) are ED2 residual; Black Stone Dragon is the final boss of the dungeon family. Not a fluff wilderness rare.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Hard Forinthry elective. Sticky Wilderness geography.

equipment_additions.name: The Shadow Reef / Ambassador (ED3)
effects: Eldritch crossbow components (t90+ ranged special weapon)
Ambassador residual unique table (dungeon final boss)
equipment_additions.notes: Accessed from eastern Daemonheim shore — Forinthry. Ironman eldritch crossbow is the region-defining ranged special from this family. Do not invent Ambassador strategy.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Hard Forinthry via Daemonheim access (official Equilibrium Forinthry example).

equipment_additions.name: Solak
effects: Torn grimoire page residual for grimoire charges
equipment_additions.notes: Lost Grove — official Tirannwn Equilibrium example. Ironman t92 dual crossbows + grimoire pocket are Solak-gated group content.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Hard Tirannwn elective. Prif access is designed to unlock with region quest completion.

equipment_additions.name: Raksha, the Shadow Colossus
effects: Shadow spike upgrades for Fleeting / Laceration / Blast diffusion boots to t90
equipment_additions.notes: Anachronia island boss. Ironman ability codices (GRico/GChain/Divert) and boot tier upgrades are the BiS reason to pick Anachronia for combat — not only BGH skilling.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Hard Anachronia elective.

equipment_additions.name: Legiones (Monastery of Ascension)
effects: Ascension signet / keystone residual for dual assembly
equipment_additions.notes: Kandarin Monastery of Ascension. Ironman t90 dual crossbows before blightbound/eldritch. Distinct from Solak t92 path.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Hard Kandarin elective.

equipment_additions.name: Temple of Aminishi (ED1)
effects: Seasinger / Tetsu / Death lotus upgrade kits (t85→88 Ports weapon residual)
equipment_additions.notes: Temple of Aminishi (Arc ED1) is Asgarnia under Equilibrium Arc packaging. Port Sarim is the practical access package. Ancient scales, Masuta warspear, and Ports t85→88 upgrade kits densify here.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Hard Asgarnia (Arc / ED1). Optional Desert Ports pressure may be added later.
